result: Exact rmcp-v3.1.4 ServerHandler exposes the minimal application-owned persistent-task RPC seam: get_task(GetTaskParams, RequestContext<RoleServer>) -> Result<GetTaskResult, McpError>; update_task(UpdateTaskParams, RequestContext<RoleServer>) -> Result<(), McpError>; cancel_task(CancelTaskParams, RequestContext<RoleServer>) -> Result<(), McpError>. Central dispatch capability-gates all three and turns successful unit returns for update/cancel into task acknowledgements, so custom handlers do not need a TaskAckResult constructor.
